pr_title: Add an option to `GlueJobOperator` to stop the job run when the TI is killed
pr_body:
<!--

closes: #32137

This PR adds a new boolean parameter `stop_job_run_on_kill`  to `GlueJobOperator`, when it is set to `True`, the Glue job run will be stopped if the TI is killed (because of a timeout or a SIGTERM/clear).

if you stop a running GlueJobOperator task ( mark fail ) the operator do not call aws glue to stop the runnning task

so the airflow task stop but the aws glue job continue to run
